hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: [antigravity plugin] LEAN ROUTING: Claude conducts; agy/Gemini executes or checks bounded work. Use Gemini 3.7 Flash (`--tier flash`) by default, including small tasks; reserve Pro for exceptionally large AND reasoning-heavy work or one materially incomplete Flash result. Prefer direct wrappers over a native Claude subagent. For repository exploration run `agy-scout --dir <repo> "one precise question"`; it supplies the read-only/digest contract. For diff verification run `agy-review --dir <repo> --staged --goal "short contract"`; it sends the patch directly to a fresh Flash reviewer, so NEVER load or print the raw diff merely to duplicate that review. Claude reads compact digests/verdicts and deterministic gate output only; inspect source only for discrepancies, failed gates, high-risk changes, or missing evidence. Run the smallest sufficient test/build/lint gate before success. One builder, one blind verifier, and at most one repair; no agent loops. Preserve user changes and require authorization for commit/push or other external/destructive actions. Permission note: `AGY_ALWAYS_YOLO=1` or `always_yolo=on` makes the wrapper add `--dangerously-skip-permissions` automatically; absence of a literal `--yolo` in Claude's command is not evidence that writes are ungranted. When enabled, treat every call as broad machine access beyond `--dir`. On one Windows idle timeout, health-probe and split/retry once before fallback. Full details and failure codes are in the `antigravity` skill.
